meta.data: data/probes/ (raw outputs of the frozen model in data/models/)

scoring.distractor_capture: distractor code present and target code absent
scoring.exact_output_compliance: cleaned output is exactly one AA-000 code
scoring.extra_token_output: exactly one expected code present but output is not code-only
scoring.invalid_output: both expected codes or neither expected code present
scoring.normalized_accuracy: target code present and distractor code absent
scoring.transport_cleanup: strip the fixed llama.cpp EOF trailer and surrounding whitespace

uncertainty.interpretation: no population confidence claim; deterministic decoding has no repeated-decoding uncertainty
uncertainty.method: descriptive summaries of the observed seeded scenario families
uncertainty.reported: point estimates, family counts, matched denominators, and paired wins/losses/ties
